This repository contains supporting code that proves the inequality
$1.4<K_G^{\mathbb{C}}<1.404898554746$, where $K_G^{\mathbb{C}}$ is the complex Grothendieck constant.  

For the upper bound certificate, run `python audit_best7_full.py`

For the lower bound certificate, run `python3 check_complex_lower.py`
